moa.t: Stimulates β1 (increases contractility and heart rate) with mild β2 vasodilation

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Dobutamine, IV infusion, 5–20 mcg/kg/minute. · Dilute 1 vial (250 mg/20 mL) up to 50 mL with sodium chloride 0.9% or dextrose 5%. (Solution = 5 mg/mL or 5 000 mcg/mL)
Dobutamine, IV, 5 to 20 mcg/kg/min as a continuous infusion.
Dobutamine, IV, 500 mg in 200 ml 0.9% saline as a continuous infusion. 23.35

dosing.h: Heart Failure, Acute with Pulmonary Oedema

items.t: Dobutamine, IV infusion, 2–15 μg/kg/minute. · Continue until myocardial function and blood pressure improve.
Dobutamine, IV infusion, 2.5–15 mcg/kg/minute. · Continue until myocardial function and blood pressure improve. · Ensure normovolaemia.

dosing.h: Hypoxia-ischaemia of the Newborn (Perinatal Hypoxia/hypoxic-ischaemic Encephalopathy (HIE))

items.t: Dobutamine, IV, 5–15 μg/kg/minute if cardiac dysfunction or failure is present. · Continue with blood pressure support until blood pressure is stabilised. Seizure Control

cautions.t: Give by infusion pump via a large vein
